descriptionChirho: Niphal: to be bound (of the tongue), hence to be dumb, mute, or silent; used of voluntary silence (Ps 39:3, 10), of a sheep silent before shearers (Isa 53:7), of divinely imposed speechlessness (Ezek 3:26, 24:27, 33:22), and of being struck speechless (Dan 10:15).

labelChirho: be made dumb, be silenced (Niphal jussive)
descriptionChirho: Niphal passive/jussive: to be made dumb or silenced, used of lying lips being silenced as a prayer for divine judgment (Ps 31:19).
Piel: to bind, tie together; used literally of binding sheaves of grain (Gen 37:7).
